LanguageData.LP_SteelDefender.label: steel defender
LanguageData.LP_SteelDefender.description: A small construct pieced together by a Battle Smith from steel and components, about the size of a dog. Doesn't eat or sleep, fights alongside its master, and steps in when the master is attacked in melee. Leaves only a pile of steel when destroyed.
